_comment: Hand-authored. The ending picture and its palette in bank 2.

regions.name: Ending picture: 10 x 13 tiles
regions.description: Bank 2 $8AC0 sets $16/$17 = $8B05, PPU $21F1, width $15 = 10 and height $14 = 13, and calls $C07E ($D99C), which queues the rectangle row by row from ($16),Y: 10 x 13 = 130 bytes, exactly this stretch. Tiles $B0-$EE framed by $F4/$F5/$F6. The same routine then copies 88 bytes from $8B87 into OAM (22 sprites) and 25 from $8BDF into the palette, and far-calls bank 0's credits roll - so this is the picture shown with the ending. The picture has NOT been checked against a savestate: none was taken at the ending.

regions.name: Ending palette: 25 bytes to $0180-$0198
regions.description: $8AEC LDA $8BDF,Y / STA $0180,Y to CPY #$19: the backdrop and all eight palettes of the ending screen, copied straight into the staging area rather than through the palette table at bank 5 $B30A. 25 bytes, ending where the font begins at $8BF8.
